reviews.text:
IF THERE WAS AN OPTION TO LEAVE NO STAR, I WOULD!!!

I took my dog here because she stopped eating and drinking water. We noticed her teeth were rotting and wanted help. Instead of running tests or finding out what was really wrong, they pushed two medications and told us to force-feed her. We were told it would be fine. It wasn’t.

After one week and $300, she was worse. She was in more pain, barely holding on, and clearly suffering. We went back and told them their medication made her worse and asked for help. Their response? That we should have done bloodwork — something they never even mentioned the first time.

They refused to take any responsibility. No apology. No solution. Just told us to pay more money before they would “help.” They didn’t care that our dog was dying right in front of them.

One day later, she passed away.
This place took our money, ignored the obvious, and let our dog suffer until it was too late.

I normally never make reviews like this but, If you love your pet, STAY AWAY from here. They care more about your wallet than your pet’s life. This is not a hospital — it’s a business that will take advantage of you when your pet is vulnerable.

The following pictures are when the Vet force fed my dog medication.

We have always brought our dogs to this vet.
Dr Gabby B is just the winning combination consistently out performs all the vets we have encountered demonstrating superior veterinary skills, assertive competence and authentic joyful compassion and kindness. Truly exemplary 🙌

Wow - VCA Aventura exceeded my expectations from start to finish . Max who took our appointment was so patient & gave us ALL the info I needed even when it entailed me calling back multiple times to bug him he was so thorough & patient & got us in same day . Andres our tech was so calm & really went above & beyond for me & my girl - Mazzy who is pretty reactive while also a bit of scaredy doggo. He went above & beyond to make us feel seen & for Mazzy to feel safe . Now Dr . Bruggeman was the absolute best Vet I’ve ever encountered seriously ! As a dog mom & having worked in the vet profession I can truly say she was the best I’ve met  . She was so so patient , gentle , understanding & Mazzy really took a liking to her ! Everyone seriously went ABOVE & BEYOND for us . It was financially doable for a pregnant single mother , Mazzy felt safe & they were patient letting her warm up to them , they got EVERY worry I had taken care of & we’re even going back in a couple days to finish up because they took her previous history of seizures into account & didn’t want to overwhelm her or her system with too much in one day . I mean they truly exceeded all expectations & brought a huge amount of peace & relief to our life . My girl Mazzy is truly my daughter but it can be very financially & emotionally overwhelming when something goes wrong & instead of leaving there feeling helpless I felt empowered & like my girl was truly well taken care of & like she left in better shape than when we arrived & that’s the goal that’s not usually met unfortunately by other vets . VCA Aventura you guys are truly the best . Dr.B , Andres & Max we thank you so deeply & will never be going anywhere else ! We actually are looking forward to seeing everyone again for Mazzy’s follow up Monday & I think she’ll be so much more relaxed knowing the good hands she’ll be in when we pull up this time . Eternally grateful  & 10000/10 recommend this hospital & this team . A++++ 5 Stars ! Thank you 🐾

I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to the wonderful team at VCA Aventura Animal Hospital for the exceptional care they provide to my dog.
My dog is my child, and when I moved from NY to FL, I carefully researched many veterinary hospitals before choosing one for her. I am so happy that my instincts led me to VCA Aventura.
The amazing Dr. Vergara, Dr. Bruggeman and Fernanda take endless care of my dog. My dog is a senior dog and requires numerous treatments, follow-up appointments, and medications, and everything is always handled on time and with the utmost professionalism.
The entire medical team, technicians and front desk staff are incredibly kind and professional. They always greet us with a smile and know the dogs by name, which makes such a difference.
I cannot thank them enough for their patience and their willingness to accommodate all of my requests. Their dedication and compassion mean the world to me.
I highly, highly recommend them!💙

I love this hospital so much! I know my pups & kitty are safe here and well taken care of. Everyone at the hospital shows nothing but love and kindness towards the pets and owners. The Doctors and technicians are so sweet and the front desk representatives are super welcoming! I especially want to thank/shout out Kayla at the front desk. She was super helpful during check in and check out!

I actually first found out about this place by chance when I met the manager, Nelly, at my job, and I'm so glad I did. The facility is always super clean and the front desk people are always so welcoming when you walk in. They have a cute welcome board in the front, water, coffee, a cute photo area.. so much to treat yourself to while you wait

My pet is a nervous pee and pooper… they don’t even let me clean it up they jump up to help it. I feel bad but the fact they are this attentive and don’t even care about it makes me feel less ashamed of my poopypants dog

I’m a total neurotic pet owner and I constantly stress over every little thing so I signed up on the plan they have that has unlimited exams, so even if it’s something small that isn’t a real emergency, I can bring my dog in and the exam is covered. The plan doesn’t include nail trims and I learned that the hard way so just a FYI lol

One of the times I came in thinking I was just being crazy again, my dog was actually really sick. I saw Dr. B and she didn't brush me off at all they took me completely seriously and did diagnostics right away. The results were pretty concerning, so they kept her for day hospitalization to treat her. I had to go to work, but Dr. B and the team kept me updated the whole day and the communication was amazing. I felt so safe leaving her there. Shoutout to Ariana and Andres who were helping the doctor that day, they were awesome.

By the time I picked her up at the end of the day, she looked like a completely different dog than when I dropped her off but in a good way.. She looked like my baby again and Nothing gives me more peace of mind than knowing I can leave my dog with people who genuinely take such good care of her.

I know Dr. B told me she is leaving the team soon but I definitely recommend her while she’s here and Dr. Vergara as well I have only seen those two so far, and I have nothing but high praises. They also have 2 other vets and I would be open to seeing them any day but haven’t had an experience with them yet so I can’t attest, but I am sure they are GREAT like everyone else

I took forever to write this review but I just told my friend about this place and gave high praises and said YA KNOW I did promise them I would leave a review! So here it is team! You all are amazing and clearly love what you do

Seriously love this place!
Our vet clinic was booked and we had an emergency so I called around and found this beautiful place! Very helpful and friendly stuff! My baby Khaki was treated well! Definitely recommend!

If you are looking for the perfect place to take your pet / babies this is definitely the right place . I am a first time dog mommy and I was so nervous when my puppy Lola got a small cough other places made me feel unheard and like I wasn’t worth their time but not this place . From when I first called the girl on the phone was so sweet and kind and willing to help me through the process of getting her an appointment right away . She made me feel comfortable before I even got to the place . Then when I came in the staff were all busy with other patients but still managed to acknowledge you as you walk in and make you and your pet feel seen. I got there early and they still checked me in and told me I might have to wait still but we’re so nice about it . It’s not their fault I was super early and they were busy but they still managed to get Lola seen pretty quickly and answered all my questions and concerns giving me different options of choices for her . They helped me calm my nerves and made me feel safe which in turn made Lola feel safe . I will always come here because the experience was amazing . Thank you to the staff here for everything you do . Me and Lola greatly appreciate you all .

I came here with my wife after a horrible experience at the Chewy Vet next door. I went to CHEWY and we were 15 minutes late because of traffic and we were turned away (like they don’t know we’re in Aventura)

Immediately, we were greeted wonderfully by the receptionist Miriam, immediately escorted into a room and she even brought us a welcome bag with things for my dog (who doesn’t like free stuff?)

On top of that they gave us a dose of the flea medication my dog was on for free since we are new (again… vet giving something away for free already blew my mind) and the nurse and doctor came (the doc was Dr. Vergara and I’m sorry but I do not remember the nurse’s name but very kind young lady) within 15 minutes, saw our dog for her ear issue, did a quick test, prescribed whatever we needed,  and we were out the door.

They didn’t make us wait in line to pay, they gave us the opportunity to sit in the exam room which is awesome because my dog (and my wife) have social anxiety. (Not sure who has more my dog or my wife) they took my card, came back and presented my receipt in a folder with all the information of what my dog had done that day. On top of that they also have an online Amazon kind of thing where I can get my dogs food and flea medication delivered so I was immediately blown away. I don’t know how the price compares because I don’t care about price - but I care about good old fashioned client service annd good treatment to my dog (and my wife).

Immediately I told my wife we were sticking with this vet. No need for putting up with disrespect by Chewy. VCA Aventura I will recommend you to everyone

Best veterinary clinic ever!! My kitten Yoshi and I had an amazing experience thanks to Dr.Gabrielle, Andres, and Nellyann!! I am so grateful to find a clinic that shows so much care and attention to our babies and the plan prices are great. Thank you for everything and I can’t wait until my next visit!

Dr.Bruggeman is  an excellent  veterinarian,  I can tell she really loves what she does , amazing service from her staff who helped me through a rough process with my frenchie who thank to them is much better . So speacial shout out to not only the doctor but also to Emily, Diana ,Mat and Andres for being patient with me and answering all my questions. If anyone is needing any medical attention for the fur babies please DO NOT HESITATE TO CONTACT VCA AVENTURA HOSPITAL AND PET RESORT. ( if possible see Dr.Bruggeman )

I boarded my cat Tux, for about 2 months.  He was treated well, because I was on a cruise, I didn’t have any way to keep in contact with VCA.  But when I was in a place that had internet; I could call, FaceTime & talk to my cat which made me happy to see him.  When I came back, he was happy to see me and he was seemed very calm and relaxed.And

The tech that helped with my dog was wonderful. The vet did ok as well. They are always great about getting my dog in fast. But I did have an issue about my dogs ears. He went in for an ear infection. They put medication in his ear and told me to come back in one week for another application. When I made the appointment to come back I was told it had to be in a week for the medication to work. I came back in a week and then was told that they used the last vial and I would have to come back the following Monday. Then it was another 4 days before the medication to come in. So another week passes by. His ears got worse and never got better. So after spending 530.00 I had to take him to another vet. I am not happy at all. Other than getting me in quickly to see someone it wasn’t a good experience.

Excellent staff, service, and care—I LOVE VCA! The entire staff is wonderful. I’ve been bringing my two little dogs here for years and have absolutely no complaints. Emily is an exceptional young woman. VCA: 10/10.
Amazing experience! Andres and Dr.Torres did an amazing job explaining everything to us and finding the right medicine for our dog! Will definitely be our vet for a long time! Really recommend!

I usually am not one who leaves reviews. HOWEVER, Miri at VCA Aventura Animal Hospital is literally THE GOAT. I requested assistance with what I thought was way too much and honestly felt like I was being a bother, but Miri handled everything like it was nothing. Super helpful, professional, patient, and genuinely caring. VCA Aventura is lucky to have someone like her because she really came through for me and my pet. Thank you again Miri you’re amazing!!!

I have all 3 of my cats enrolled here with VCA they provide great care and love to my babies and understand how much I love them. I actually adopted one directly from VCA AVENTURA. Her name was PULGA but i renamed her SIX. She is 7-9 months old and had a rough upbringing so i decided to give her some life in her life and brought her home to meet her siblings VEGAS & KANE. NOw im a kitty papi of 3. 😍

I visited today. It was an amazing experience. Both my dogs are very nervous but Thalia and Dr. Torres treated them both with so much love. Thalia and Dr.Torres did a great job explaining everything so in detailed. Great place !

Emely and Larissa did a beautiful job on my dogs' nails. They were patient and calm with both dogs including the one who hates to have his paws touched. His pedicure is better than mine.  Thank you ladies!  Definitely recommend.
